game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Shadow Cave – Crystal Grotto, a grotto of glowing crystals: the spelunker must handle rock golems while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Digit Mill: Peel digits off a number with while n > 0 using // and %.
theme: Shadow Cave – Crystal Grotto: a grotto of glowing crystals
core_gameplay_loop: In Crystal Grotto, repeat each round: Peel digits off a number with while n > 0 using // and %. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the digits value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 13 consecutive correct decisions about digits to power up the spelunker and open the wooden door.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 9 (extended tier): Digit Mill
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Digit Mill' (Week 4 slot 13), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Crystal Grotto'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how digits changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rock golems in Crystal Grotto.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 13.
